clue.text: Landlord deserving financial authorisation

parts.note: a landlord lets property, so is a letter
something deserving is of credit, worthy of praise

explanation.surface: A landlord who deserves a loan approval from the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'Landlord' as one who lets: a LETTER. A letter of credit is a bank's written undertaking to pay.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank document guaranteeing payment is a classic instrument of financial authorisation.

clue.text: Hate seeing the French keeping a promise

indicators.note: keeping means holding something inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: le is French for 'the'
an oath is a solemn promise

explanation.surface: Someone loathes how the French keep their word.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to hate something intensely is to detest it.

clue.text: Lofty's popular in Estonia

parts.note: lofty means tall; the 's is a link meaning 'is'
in means popular, fashionable

explanation.surface: A tall man nicknamed Lofty is well liked in Estonia.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the Estonian capital, here in the spelling with one N; the definition simply places it in Estonia.
explanation.definitionFit: The Estonian capital city is a place located in Estonia, so the vague location serves as definition.

clue.text: Former employer initially axed worker for performing

parts.note: ex- means former

indicators.note: initially picks out the opening letter of employer

parts.note: axed means cut
the ant is the crossword's standard worker

explanation.surface: An ex-boss sacked a staff member for showing off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'axed' looks like sacking but just gives CUT; 'for performing' defines a performer, someone who carries out.
explanation.definitionFit: An executant is a performer, especially of music, so a person who is there for performing.

clue.text: Honest setter becomes homeless

indicators.note: becomes signals that the letters turn into something else, a rearrangement

explanation.surface: A truthful crossword setter ends up sleeping rough.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: people living on the streets have no home to go to.

clue.text: See 1
Wine from South American port gets German approval

parts.note: Rio de Janeiro, the Brazilian port, is often shortened to Rio
ja is German for yes

explanation.surface: A wine shipped from Rio gets the thumbs up in Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Rioja is a red wine from the Spanish region of that name.

clue.text: Passes on fury about Academy's Latin hymn

parts.note: passes on is a euphemism for dies

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so fury goes round the abbreviation

parts.note: ire is fury, anger
A is a standard abbreviation for Academy

explanation.surface: Someone dies raging at the Academy over a Latin hymn.
explanation.definitionFit: The 'Day of Wrath' is a medieval Latin hymn used in the Requiem Mass.

clue.text: Suffered broken toe? See!

parts.note: taken can mean suffered, as in taken a beating

indicators.note: broken signals the letters of toe are smashed into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone has broken a toe and is told to look at it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See!' reads like pointing at the injured foot, but it is an imperative defining the whole phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Imperative synonym: 'take note!' and 'see!' both tell someone to pay attention.

clue.text: Men in tails contrived complaints

indicators.note: contrived means artificially arranged, so the letters are reorganised

explanation.surface: Men in tailcoats invented their ailments.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: complaints in the medical sense are illnesses or disorders.

clue.text: Knock out film star for old foreign coin

parts.note: KO is the boxing abbreviation for knockout
Gregory Peck, the Hollywood star

explanation.surface: Knocking out a movie star to grab an antique coin.
explanation.definitionFit: A kopeck is a Russian coin, a hundredth of a rouble, once in wide use.

clue.text: Cruel nature upsetting to one's father

indicators.note: upsetting means overturning, so these words are thrown into a fresh order

parts.note: one's gives its letters as written, including the S

explanation.surface: A cruel streak that upsets a person's father.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: someone with a heart of stone is pitiless, cruel by nature.

clue.text: Verse form starts to harvest accolades in Kyoto University

indicators.note: starts to picks out the opening letter of each of the next three words

parts.note: KU abbreviates Kyoto University

explanation.surface: Poems about the harvest win prizes at a Japanese university.
explanation.definitionFit: A haiku is a short Japanese poetic form of three lines and seventeen syllables.

clue.text: Joy about English victory and promotion

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so joy goes round the two abbreviations

parts.note: elation is joy

explanation.surface: Delight over an English win and going up a division.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: being raised to a higher rank is an elevation.

clue.text: Unimaginative material — rotten play!

parts.note: matter is material, substance
food gone off is rotten
an act is part of a play, and to act is to play

explanation.surface: A critic calls the stuff a rotten play.
explanation.walkthrough: The dash makes 'rotten play' look like a theatre critic's verdict on the material.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone matter-of-fact is prosaic and practical, lacking imagination.

clue.text: Preparedness to battle when stealing minerals

indicators.note: stealing means taking in, so battle takes the minerals inside it

parts.note: a fight is a battle
ores are minerals mined for metal

explanation.surface: Readiness for war when looting mineral wealth.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: foresight is planning ahead, a state of readiness for what comes.

clue.text: Soldier in the process of growing old is of the same mind

indicators.note: in places the soldier inside the following phrase

parts.note: ageing is the process of growing old
RE, Royal Engineers, stands for soldiers

explanation.surface: An ageing soldier finds himself agreeing with everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: people who concur hold the same opinion.

clue.text: Sailor's disquisition is philosophical

parts.note: AB, able-bodied seaman, is a sailor; the 's is kept as S
a tract is a treatise or disquisition

explanation.surface: A sailor's essay turns out to be deeply philosophical.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: abstract thinking is theoretical, concerned with ideas rather than things.

clue.text: Take heed of top management or come to grief

definitions.meaning: read literally, to follow the board of directors
the idiom means to be abandoned or lost, to fail

explanation.walkthrough: The idiom originally meant to fall overboard; the playful first reading takes the board as a company's directors.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: plans that are dropped or ruined have met failure.

clue.text: Harangue one stuck in traffic

indicators.note: stuck in places the numeral inside the word for traffic

parts.note: traffic means trade, commerce
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lone driver stuck in traffic goes on a rant.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a long angry speech is a tirade.

clue.text: Implement left inside supports

indicators.note: inside places the abbreviation within the word for supports

parts.note: piers are supporting pillars

explanation.surface: A tool has been left inside the supporting columns.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: pliers are a gripping hand tool.

clue.text: Interest I developed in illness

indicators.note: developed means grown into a new form, so the letters reorganise

explanation.surface: My interest grew into a sickness.
explanation.definitionFit: Enteritis is inflammation of the intestine, a disease.

clue.text: Intensify approval initially lacking

indicators.note: initially lacking means the word loses its opening letter

parts.note: praise is approval

explanation.surface: Boosting effort when early praise is missing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to raise is to increase, as in raising the stakes.

clue.text: Upset son's medication

parts.note: S abbreviates son
a pill is medication

explanation.surface: A son becomes upset about his medicine.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to upset a cup is to spill it, knocking its contents out.

clue.text: Character with inclination for one toiletry, including iodine

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: including means taking in, so the powder holds the chemical symbol

parts.note: talc is a toiletry powder
I is the chemical symbol for iodine

explanation.surface: Someone with a fondness for a talc laced with iodine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inclination' looks like a liking, but means a slant.
explanation.definitionFit: Italic type is a style of letter that slopes to the right.

clue.text: Old woman wearing cosmetic? That's hard to digest!

indicators.note: wearing means one is inside the other, as a person inside clothes

parts.note: rouge is a cosmetic
a hag is an ugly old woman

explanation.surface: A crone wearing blusher is not a pretty sight.
explanation.definitionFit: Roughage is dietary fibre, the part of food the body cannot break down.

clue.text: Threaten to go out in Golf, say

parts.note: G is Golf in the NATO phonetic alphabet
to utter is to say

explanation.surface: A golfer threatens to walk out.
explanation.definitionFit: A candle gutters when it flickers and is close to being extinguished.

clue.text: Savages cook fowl

parts.note: to heat food is to cook it
hens are domestic fowl

explanation.surface: Savages cooking chickens.
explanation.definitionFit: Heathens, used loosely, are uncivilised people, barbarians.
